name: archive-nav
title: Archive nav
description: A blog or changelog archive by year and month, with post counts, the current period open and the rest folded.
docs: Pass periods (year and months, each with month 1 to 12, count and href), current ({ year, month }) and your application locale. The current year is open and the others are disclosure buttons with aria-expanded; a month is a link (drawn by linkAs, your router Link) only if it has posts, and the current one is marked aria-current="page". Without an href, a month is a button that calls onNavigate. Month names are worked out from the locale. The newest collapsedCount years (default 5) show and the rest sit behind a Show earlier years button that never moves, so keyboard focus stays on it; if the current page is in an older year they start shown. The list is one nav landmark, named Archive by default.
